name: COMP_029
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (47%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged low reliability [F6], three-class ambiguity [F1], and simulated frozen-section margins [F7] warrant deferral.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 47%, Benign 38%, Normal 15%, Invasive 1% (ECE 5%) | InSitu leads; Benign close second |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate three non-invasive classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 20% reliability, 90% OOD (error AUROC 70%) | Suspect input; recut H&E drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match InSitu (3 Benign, 2 Normal, 88%–89% similarity) [F5] | Neighbors favor Benign or Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive likelihood [F2]; 12/20 AI spot checks · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Typical descriptive score [F3]; 8/20 AI spot checks · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score [F4], but unreliable concept (0/20 AI spot checks) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive likelihood; 20/20 AI spot checks · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (3-region deletion 95% CI excludes zero, n=132); risk concentrates in region 8 (7%).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI includes zero); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Low-reliability composite frozen section misled the classifier over Benign (38%) or Normal (15%), which match all similar cases.
- Deeper levels or permanent sections uncover stromal invasion near region 8 (7% risk) or at deferred margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 10, 11**: Verify whether atypical epithelium is truly confined within ducts versus frozen-section artifact.
2. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect highest-risk region 8 (7% risk) for stromal infiltration versus benign fibrous stroma.
3. **Regions 1, 4**: Check tubules and lymphocytes; evaluate section quality for drafted recut and deeper levels.
